exposure: Eligibility for low-dose aspirin prophylaxis based on Israeli guidelines and ACOG criteria
Preeclampsia risk factors (history of preeclampsia, pregestational diabetes, chronic hypertension, autoimmune diseases, moderate-risk factors)
outcome: Receipt of low-dose aspirin prescription for preeclampsia prevention
cohort: Women who delivered live births at a tertiary medical center in northern Israel between March 2020 and April 2024.
finding: The study revealed suboptimal prescription of low-dose aspirin according to guideline criteria, especially among women with moderate-risk factors, with disparities in prescribing practices persisting even among women with high-risk factors.
